yearlyPlan.guidance.title: Heading of the plan-guidance card at the top of the yearly plan (legacy page and Reports tab).
yearlyPlan.guidance.nextStep: Small label above the single most useful thing to do now.
yearlyPlan.guidance.checklistTitle: Heading of the list of activities that still need something.
yearlyPlan.guidance.allGood: Shown in the checklist when no activity needs attention.
yearlyPlan.guidance.open: Button on a checklist row: opens that activity so the problem can be fixed.
yearlyPlan.next.EMPTY_PLAN.text: Next-step card when the plan has no activity at all.
yearlyPlan.next.EMPTY_PLAN.button: Button of the empty-plan card: goes to the activity list.
yearlyPlan.next.NO_LOCATION.text: Next-step card when an activity that can be drawn on the map has no place yet. {{activity}} = activity name.
yearlyPlan.next.NO_LOCATION.button: Button: opens the activity so its place can be shown on the map.
yearlyPlan.next.PLACEHOLDER_quantity.tex: Next-step card when only the quantity is still the starting value (1). {{activity}} = activity name.
yearlyPlan.next.PLACEHOLDER_budget.text: Next-step card when only the budget is still the starting value (NPR 5,000). {{activity}} = activity name.
yearlyPlan.next.PLACEHOLDER_both.text: Next-step card when both quantity and budget are still the starting values. {{activity}} = activity name.
yearlyPlan.next.NOT_PLANNED_ANY_YEAR.tex: Next-step card when an activity has 0 quantity and 0 budget in all ten years. {{activity}} = activity name.
yearlyPlan.next.NOT_PLANNED_ANY_YEAR.but: Button: opens the activity so years can be chosen.
yearlyPlan.next.FEATURE_YEAR_UNPLANNED.t: Next-step card when a place is set for a year in which the activity is not planned. {{activity}} = activity name, {{years}} = the year number(s).
yearlyPlan.next.FEATURE_YEAR_UNPLANNED.b: Button: opens the activity so that year can be planned.
yearlyPlan.next.UNUSUAL_AMOUNT.text: Next-step card when a yearly budget is far above the other activities (a possible typing mistake). {{activity}} = activity name, {{amount}} = the yearly budget in the current number style.
yearlyPlan.next.UNUSUAL_AMOUNT.button: Button: opens the activity so the amount can be checked.
yearlyPlan.next.NO_BUDGET_ANY_YEAR.text: Next-step card when an activity has no budget in any year (community / voluntary work?). {{activity}} = activity name.
yearlyPlan.next.NO_BUDGET_ANY_YEAR.butto: Button: confirms that the numbers are intended.
yearlyPlan.next.ALL_READY.text: Card shown when nothing needs attention. {{activities}} = number of activities, {{total}} = ten-year budget (both in the current number style).
yearlyPlan.next.ALL_READY.button: Button: goes on to create the plan document.
yearlyPlan.state.needs_location: Small status tag on an activity that can be drawn on the map but has no place yet.
yearlyPlan.state.needs_numbers: Small status tag on an activity whose quantity or budget still has the starting value, or that is not planned in any year.
yearlyPlan.state.needs_review: Small status tag on an activity with something to double-check (unusual amount, no budget, a place in an unplanned year).
yearlyPlan.state.ready: Small status tag on an activity with nothing missing.
yearlyPlan.confirm.button: Button next to the starting-value warning: the user says the numbers are right as they are.
yearlyPlan.confirm.done: Toast after the user confirmed an activity's numbers.
yearlyPlan.saved.ok: Small toast after a change is saved.
yearlyPlan.cba.outOfDate: Banner on the cost-benefit analysis page when the yearly plan changed after the analysis was last updated.
yearlyPlan.cba.update: Button on that banner: re-populates the analysis from the plan.
yearlyPlan.cba.updated: Toast after the analysis was updated from the plan.
yearlyPlan.cba.placeholderNote: Note on the cost-benefit analysis page while some plan activities still have the starting numbers (they are counted as costs).
yearlyPlan.error.saveConnection: Error toast when a save fails because there is no connection.
yearlyPlan.error.saveInvalid: Error toast when the server refuses a value (for example a negative amount).
yearlyPlan.error.saveConflict: Error toast when someone else changed the activity (on the map or another page) while it was being edited.
yearlyPlan.error.saveGeneric: Error toast for any other failed save. Says the data is safe.
yearlyPlan.error.loadFailed: Error message when the plan could not be loaded.
yearlyPlan.error.addFailed: Error toast when adding an activity failed.
yearlyPlan.error.removeFailed: Error toast when removing an activity failed.
yearlyPlan.error.reload: Button on the conflict message: reloads the latest version.
yearlyPlan.guidance.progress: Progress line under the heading. {{ready}} = activities ready, {{total}} = all activities (both in the current number style). Worded so it reads correctly for any number, including 1.
yearlyPlan.find.title: Heading of the activity finder (search box, filters and the browse tree).
yearlyPlan.find.searchLabel: Accessible name of the search box (read by screen readers; not shown).
yearlyPlan.find.placeholder: Grey example text inside the empty search box. The examples are words people type; keep them.
yearlyPlan.find.hint: Small line under the search box telling people they may type in either language.
yearlyPlan.find.clear: Accessible name of the small ✕ button that empties the search box.
yearlyPlan.find.showing: Live count under the search box. {{n}} = activities currently listed, {{total}} = all activities.
yearlyPlan.find.resultsLabel: Accessible name of the list of results (screen readers).
yearlyPlan.find.noMatch: Shown when a search finds nothing. {{query}} = what the person typed. Must stay friendly and say what to do next.
yearlyPlan.find.noMatchFilters: Shown when the chosen filters (map, unit, in my plan …) leave no activity.
yearlyPlan.find.closest: Heading above the three suggested activities when a search finds nothing.
yearlyPlan.find.browseTitle: Heading of the group-by-group list a person can open instead of typing.
yearlyPlan.find.expandAll: Button that opens every group of the browse list.
yearlyPlan.find.collapseAll: Button that closes every group of the browse list.
yearlyPlan.find.groupCount: Under a group name. {{n}} = activities in the group, {{map}} = how many of them can be shown on the map.
yearlyPlan.find.loadFailed: Shown when the master list of activities could not be fetched from the server.
yearlyPlan.find.noneYet: Shown when the master list is empty.
yearlyPlan.find.filters.title: Label above the filter chips.
yearlyPlan.find.filters.map: Filter chip: only activities that can be drawn or placed on the map.
yearlyPlan.find.filters.noMap: Filter chip: only activities that need no map (meetings, training, salaries …).
yearlyPlan.find.filters.symbol: Label of the map-symbol chips (nursery, plantation, fire line …).
yearlyPlan.find.filters.unit: Label of the unit chips: what the activity is counted in (hectares, kilometres, times …).
yearlyPlan.find.filters.inPlan: Filter chip: only activities that are already lines of this forest's plan.
yearlyPlan.find.filters.notInPlan: Filter chip: only activities not yet in this forest's plan.
yearlyPlan.find.filters.recent: Filter chip: the activities this person chose lately on this computer.
yearlyPlan.find.filters.recentNone: Shown after pressing "Recently used" when the person has not chosen anything yet in this browser.
yearlyPlan.find.filters.clear: Button that removes every filter chip.
yearlyPlan.find.card.choose: Button on an activity that is not in the plan yet: adds it to the plan.
yearlyPlan.find.card.open: Button on an activity that is already in the plan: opens it.
yearlyPlan.find.card.inPlan: Tag on an activity that is already in the plan.
yearlyPlan.find.card.inPlanYears: Tag on an activity already in the plan. {{years}} = the plan years it is planned in, for example "1–3, 7".
yearlyPlan.find.map.area: Under an activity: it is drawn as an area (polygon) on the map.
yearlyPlan.find.map.line: Under an activity: it is drawn as a line on the map.
yearlyPlan.find.map.point: Under an activity: it is marked as a point on the map.
yearlyPlan.find.map.generic: Under an activity that can be placed on the map (shape not fixed).
yearlyPlan.find.map.none: Under an activity that needs no map.
yearlyPlan.find.unit.hectare: Under an activity counted in hectares (हेक्टर).
yearlyPlan.find.unit.kilometre: Under an activity counted in kilometres (कि.मि.).
yearlyPlan.find.unit.piece: Under an activity counted as a number of items (वटा).
yearlyPlan.find.unit.time: Under an activity counted in occasions (पटक).
yearlyPlan.find.unit.person: Under an activity counted in people (जना).
yearlyPlan.find.unit.place: Under an activity counted in places (स्थान).
yearlyPlan.find.unit.asneeded: Under an activity whose unit in the master list is the abbreviation "आ.अ.". Drafted as "as needed" (आवश्यकता अनुसार) — the reviewer should confirm this reading.
yearlyPlan.find.unit.load: Under an activity counted in head-loads (भारी).
yearlyPlan.find.unit.cubicfeet: Under an activity counted in cubic feet (क्यु.फि.), used for timber.
yearlyPlan.find.unit.kilogram: Under an activity counted in kilograms (के.जी.).
yearlyPlan.find.unit.stack: Under an activity counted in stacks (चट्टा), used for fuelwood.
yearlyPlan.find.unit.day: Under an activity counted in days (दिवस).
yearlyPlan.find.unit.kind: Under an activity counted in kinds (किसिम).
yearlyPlan.find.unit.other: Under an activity whose unit has no dedicated wording. {{unit}} = the unit exactly as the master list writes it.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.development: One plain sentence describing the "development" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.protection: One plain sentence describing the "protection" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.silviculture: One plain sentence describing the "silviculture" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.utilisation: One plain sentence describing the "utilisation" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.capacity: One plain sentence describing the "capacity" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.poverty: One plain sentence describing the "poverty" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.enterprise: One plain sentence describing the "enterprise" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.ecotourism: One plain sentence describing the "ecotourism" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.climate: One plain sentence describing the "climate" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.institutional: One plain sentence describing the "institutional" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.office: One plain sentence describing the "office" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.community: One plain sentence describing the "community" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.programme.admin: One plain sentence describing the "admin" group of activities, shown under the group name in the browse list. Write for a village reader, not an official.
yearlyPlan.find.yourPlanTable: Heading above the table of the activities that are already in this forest's plan (with their year cells), below the activity finder.
yearlyPlan.table.yearsEdit: Tooltip / accessible name of the button in the Years cell of the activity-features table that opens the year chooser.
yearlyPlan.table.yearsTitle: Heading of the year chooser: the plan years (1–10) this drawn place belongs to.
yearlyPlan.table.yearsApply: Button of the year chooser: saves the chosen years.
yearlyPlan.table.yearsCancel: Button of the year chooser: closes it without changing anything.
yearlyPlan.table.yearsPick: Shown in the year chooser when no year is ticked; at least one year is needed.
yearlyPlan.table.yearLabel: Accessible name of one year tick-box. {{n}} = the plan year number, 1 to 10.
yearlyPlan.table.yearsNone: Shown in the Years cell when a place has no year.
yearlyPlan.table.planYearTitle: Title of the question shown when a place is given a year in which its activity is not in the plan.
yearlyPlan.table.planYearBody: The question itself. {{activity}} = activity name, {{years}} = the year number(s), for example "4" or "4, 5".
yearlyPlan.table.planYearOk: Button: yes, plan the activity in that year too (it gets the activity’s usual quantity and budget).
yearlyPlan.table.planYearCancel: Button: no, leave the place in its previous years.
yearlyPlan.table.symbolDefault: Choice in the symbol drop-down that removes the override, so the activity’s own usual map symbol is used.
yearlyPlan.export.menu: Label of the Export button (opens a small menu of the two named files).
yearlyPlan.export.plan: Menu item: downloads the whole yearly plan (every activity, also those that need no map) as a CSV file.
yearlyPlan.export.features: Menu item: downloads the places drawn on the map (one row per place) as a CSV file.
yearlyPlan.export.saveFirstTitle: Title of the question shown when the person presses Export while changes on the page are not saved.
yearlyPlan.export.saveFirstBody: Explains why the question appears: an exported file always holds saved data only.
yearlyPlan.export.saveAndExport: Button: save the page first, then download the file.
yearlyPlan.export.exportSaved: Button: download the file with the last saved data and leave the unsaved changes as they are.
yearlyPlan.export.failed: Shown when the export file could not be produced. Reassures that nothing was changed.
yearlyPlan.export.done: Shown after the export file was downloaded.
yearlyPlan.bar.title: Small label of the bar on the map that says what to do next in the yearly plan.
yearlyPlan.bar.openPlan: Button of the map bar: opens the yearly-plan page, for steps that are not done on the map (numbers, review).
yearlyPlan.bar.showLayer: Button of the map bar: turns on the Activity Features layer, for steps done on the map (drawing a place).
yearlyPlan.bar.hide: Button that folds the next-step bar away so it does not cover the map.
yearlyPlan.bar.show: Small button that brings the folded next-step bar back.
yearlyPlan.error.tableFailed: Shown when an edit in the activity-features table (name, years, symbol) could not be saved for a reason other than connection or conflict.
yearlyPlan.wizard.title: Heading of the card on the map that walks a person through adding an activity to the yearly plan, one question at a time.
yearlyPlan.wizard.stepOf: Small progress line of the card. {{n}} = the current step, {{total}} = how many steps this activity has.
yearlyPlan.wizard.back: Button: go to the previous question of the add-activity card.
yearlyPlan.wizard.next: Button: go to the next question of the add-activity card.
yearlyPlan.wizard.skip: Button: leave an optional question unanswered (on "Where" it means "decide later").
yearlyPlan.wizard.close: Accessible name of the button that closes the add-activity card.
yearlyPlan.wizard.save: Button on the last step: saves the activity into the plan.
yearlyPlan.wizard.saveAdd: Button on the last step: saves, then starts another place of the same activity.
yearlyPlan.wizard.saving: Text shown on the save button while it is working.
yearlyPlan.wizard.addButton: Button on the map that opens the add-activity card.
yearlyPlan.wizard.what.question: First question of the add-activity card.
yearlyPlan.wizard.what.help: One line of help under the first question.
yearlyPlan.wizard.what.inPlanTitle: Title of the note shown when the chosen activity is already in the plan and needs no place on the map.
yearlyPlan.wizard.what.inPlanOpen: Button of that note: opens the yearly-plan page where the numbers are changed.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.question: Question about the place of an activity that can be shown on the map.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.help: One line of help under that question.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.map: Answer: I will draw it on the map.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.whole: Answer: it applies to the whole forest, nothing to draw.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.later: Answer: I will show the place later; the plan keeps a reminder.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.helpPoint: Instruction while the point tool is active on the map.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.helpLine: Instruction while the line tool is active on the map.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.helpPolygon: Instruction while the area tool is active on the map.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.shape: Label of the choice of drawing shape, offered only for activities that have no fixed shape.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.drawn: How many places have been drawn so far. {{n}} = the count.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.removePlace: Accessible name of the button that removes one drawn place. {{n}} = its number in the list.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.drawing: Shown while a drawing tool is armed on the map.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.noneYet: Shown when nothing has been drawn yet.
yearlyPlan.wizard.when.question: Question about the plan years (1 to 10) the activity happens in.
yearlyPlan.wizard.when.help: Explains that a year not chosen counts as nothing planned.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.question: Question about quantity and money.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.help: One line of help: money is in rupees and may be zero.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.quantity: Label of the quantity box. {{unit}} = the activity's unit (hectare, kilometre, times …).
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.quantityUnitle: Label of the quantity box when the unit is not known.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.measured: Hint under the quantity box: what the drawing measures. {{value}} = the number, {{unit}} = the unit.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.useMeasured: Button: put the measured amount into the quantity box.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.budget: Label of the budget box: the amount in Nepali rupees spent in each year.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.same: Choice: the same quantity and budget in every chosen year.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.different: Choice: enter quantity and budget for each year separately.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.year: Column heading of the year-by-year grid.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.total: Live total. {{years}} = a phrase such as "Years 1–3", {{total}} = the amount already formatted.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.unusual: Warning before saving a very large amount. {{amount}} = the largest yearly amount, already formatted.
yearlyPlan.wizard.howMuch.invalid: Shown when a number is missing or not acceptable.
yearlyPlan.wizard.name.question: Optional question: a name for the drawn place(s).
yearlyPlan.wizard.name.help: One line of help: the name shows on the map; empty means the activity name is used.
yearlyPlan.wizard.confirm.question: Last question: the person confirms the summary sentence.
yearlyPlan.wizard.confirm.years: Part of the summary sentence. {{years}} = the chosen years, for example "1–3".
yearlyPlan.wizard.confirm.places: Part of the summary sentence. {{n}} = number of drawn places.
yearlyPlan.wizard.confirm.whole: Part of the summary sentence for an activity that applies to the whole forest.
yearlyPlan.wizard.confirm.later: Part of the summary sentence when the place will be decided later.
yearlyPlan.wizard.confirm.existing: Part of the summary sentence when a new place is added to an activity that is already in the plan.
yearlyPlan.wizard.confirm.moneySame: Part of the summary sentence. {{yearly}} = the amount per year, {{total}} = the total over the chosen years; both already formatted.
yearlyPlan.wizard.confirm.moneyVaries: Part of the summary sentence when the amount differs by year. {{total}} = the total, already formatted.
yearlyPlan.wizard.done.placesSaved: Message after adding places to an activity that was already in the plan. {{n}} = how many.
yearlyPlan.wizard.error.save: Shown when saving failed. Reassures that the typed answers are kept.
yearlyPlan.wizard.error.somePlaces: Shown when only some drawn places could be saved. {{n}} = how many failed.
yearlyPlan.wizard.minimize: Tooltip of the button that folds the add-activity card down to its title bar, so the map can be drawn on without the card covering it.
yearlyPlan.wizard.restore: Tooltip of the same button while the card is folded: shows the questions again.
yearlyPlan.check.titleCreate: Title of the dialog shown before the operational plan document is created when something in the yearly plan still needs attention. {{n}} = how many things. Must read correctly for 1.
yearlyPlan.check.titleExport: Same, shown before a yearly-plan file is exported. {{n}} = how many things.
yearlyPlan.check.intro: Line under that title: the check only warns; the person may go on without fixing anything.
yearlyPlan.check.emptyPlan: Row of the check when the yearly plan has no activity at all.
yearlyPlan.check.cbaOutOfDate: Row of the check when the cost-benefit analysis no longer matches the yearly plan (it is never updated automatically).
yearlyPlan.check.subAreasNoPlan: Row of the check when sub-areas have no yearly-plan activity yet; {{count}} is how many. Unlike the other rows this one blocks issuing the plan.
yearlyPlan.check.goBack: Button of the check: closes it so the person can fix what it listed. Each listed activity also has an Open button.
yearlyPlan.check.continueCreate: Button of the check before creating the plan document: goes on without fixing.
yearlyPlan.check.continueExport: Button of the check before exporting a file: goes on without fixing.
yearlyPlan.home.tabPlan: Name of the first tab on the yearly-activities pages: the activities already in the forest's plan, as an editable table. It is the tab the page opens on.
yearlyPlan.home.tabBrowse: Name of the second tab: the finder for choosing an activity from the whole master list of activities.
yearlyPlan.home.editOnMap: Button / link that opens the map workspace of the forest, where the places of activities are drawn.
yearlyPlan.home.locationDetails: Link in the Location cell of the yearly-plan table on the yearly-activities pages: opens where the activity applies (blocks, sub-areas) and its drawn places.
yearlyPlan.home.wizardTitle: Accessible name of the side panel with the add-activity questions.
yearlyPlan.wizard.what.inPlanBodyHere: Shown in the add-activity questions of the yearly-activities pages when the chosen activity is already in the plan. {{activity}} = activity name. The numbers are changed in the table on the same page.
yearlyPlan.wizard.what.inPlanShow: Button in that message: goes to the activity's row in the table.
yearlyPlan.wizard.where.noDrawHere: Help line under the where-answers of the add-activity questions on pages that have no map: the place is drawn later on the map.
yearlyPlan.planTable.viewLabel: Accessible name of the two-way switch above the map's table (screen readers only).
yearlyPlan.planTable.viewFeatures: Switch option: the table lists the places drawn on the map, one row per place.
yearlyPlan.planTable.viewPlan: Switch option: the table lists the yearly plan, one row per activity in the plan, whether or not it has a place on the map.
yearlyPlan.planTable.colActivity: Column heading of the yearly-plan table: the activity's name.
yearlyPlan.planTable.colProgramme: Column heading: the programme (group of activities) the activity belongs to.
yearlyPlan.planTable.colUnit: Column heading: what the quantity is counted in (hectares, kilometres, number of places).
yearlyPlan.planTable.colQuantity: Column heading: the quantity used for a year unless that year has its own.
yearlyPlan.planTable.colBudget: Column heading: the budget in Nepali rupees used for a year unless that year has its own.
yearlyPlan.planTable.colReview: Column heading of the yearly-plan table: whether the numbers of the activity have been checked.
yearlyPlan.planTable.reviewPlaceholder: Small orange tag: the quantity and/or budget of this activity is still the value the system started with, so nobody has entered real numbers yet.
yearlyPlan.planTable.reviewConfirmed: Small grey text: the person said the numbers of this activity are right.
yearlyPlan.planTable.reviewTitleQuantity: Hover text of the orange tag when only the quantity is still the starting value (1).
yearlyPlan.planTable.reviewTitleBudget: Hover text of the orange tag when only the budget is still the starting value (NPR 5,000).
yearlyPlan.planTable.reviewTitleBoth: Hover text of the orange tag when both quantity and budget are still the starting values.
yearlyPlan.planTable.openButton: Label of the button in the map workspace's header bar that opens the yearly-plan table.
yearlyPlan.planTable.openButtonTitle: Tooltip and accessible name of that header button.
yearlyPlan.error.notOwner: Error toast when a save is refused because the person is not the owner of the forest (only the owner may change its yearly plan), or because the item was already removed (the server answers the same way). Says nothing was changed.
yearlyPlan.planTable.notOwner: Shown instead of the yearly-plan table when the person is not the owner of the forest: only the owner may see or change its yearly plan.
yearlyPlan.planTable.editTip: Hover text of a number in the yearly-plan table that can be changed by pressing it.
yearlyPlan.planTable.editQuantity: Label of the quantity field when a number of the yearly-plan table is being changed.
yearlyPlan.planTable.editBudget: Label of the budget field (Nepali rupees) when a number is being changed.
yearlyPlan.planTable.editYearTitle: Title of the small panel for changing one year. {{n}} = the year number 1-10.
yearlyPlan.planTable.editZeroHint: Help line in that panel: typing 0 in both fields means nothing is planned in that year.
yearlyPlan.planTable.editInvalid: Shown under a field when what was typed is not a number of 0 or more.
yearlyPlan.planTable.editInvalidQuantity: Shown under the usual-quantity field when what was typed is not a number above 0 (the usual quantity of an activity cannot be 0).
yearlyPlan.planTable.filledForAll: Quiet message after the first number typed for an activity was also used for its other years that still had the starting value. Followed by an Undo button.
yearlyPlan.planTable.undone: Quiet message after the last change was undone.
yearlyPlan.planTable.undo: Button that undoes the last change to the yearly plan.
yearlyPlan.planTable.measured: Small line under the usual quantity of an activity whose places are drawn on the map, shown when what they measure differs from the quantity. {{value}} = the measured number, {{unit}} = the activity's unit (hectare, kilometre, number of places).
yearlyPlan.planTable.useMeasured: Link next to that line: sets the usual quantity to the measured number. Nothing changes unless it is pressed.
yearlyPlan.planTable.openFullPlan: Button above the yearly-plan table on the map: opens the full yearly-activities page (in a new tab), which also has the charts that preview the operational plan.
yearlyPlan.planTable.expand: Button above the yearly-plan table: opens the same table in a large panel over the map, because the table has many columns and the side panel is narrow.
yearlyPlan.planTable.colLocation: Column heading of the yearly-plan table: where the activity happens. Left empty for activities that need no map.
yearlyPlan.planTable.placesCount: Button in the Location cell: how many places of the activity are drawn on the map (pressing it selects them). {{n}} = the number. Must read correctly for 1.
yearlyPlan.planTable.inUnits: Small line under the place count naming the forest units (blocks or compartments) the places are in. {{units}} = the names, comma separated, for example C-1, C-3.
yearlyPlan.planTable.wholeForest: Location cell of an activity that applies to the whole forest rather than to drawn places.
yearlyPlan.planTable.needsLocation: Location cell of an activity that can be drawn on the map but has no place yet.
yearlyPlan.planTable.showOnMap: Link under that message: opens the add-place questions for the activity so it can be shown on the map.
yearlyPlan.planTable.colTotal: Column heading: the activity's budget added up over all its years, in Nepali rupees.
yearlyPlan.planTable.yearShort: Very short column heading of one plan year in the yearly-plan table (Y1 … Y10). {{n}} = the year number 1–10. Must stay a few characters wide.
yearlyPlan.planTable.selectPlaces: Tooltip and accessible name of the place count in the yearly-plan table: pressing it selects that activity's places on the map and zooms to them.
yearlyPlan.planTable.sharedTag: Small grey tag beside the quantity in the places table, shown when several places of one activity share one quantity. {{n}} = how many places share it. Reads like "shared ×3".
yearlyPlan.planTable.sharedTitle: Hover text of that tag: the quantity belongs to the activity (its plan line), not to each place. {{n}} = how many places share it.
yearlyPlan.planTable.yearNotPlanned: Hover / screen-reader text of a dimmed cell: that year has quantity 0 and budget 0, so nothing is planned. {{n}} = the year number.
yearlyPlan.planTable.yearSummary: Hover / screen-reader text of a planned cell. {{n}} = the year number, {{quantity}} = the quantity, {{budget}} = the budget in Nepali rupees.
yearlyPlan.planTable.gridHint: One explanatory line above the yearly-plan table: quantity is shown above and budget below in each year cell, and a dimmed dash means nothing is planned (both are 0).
yearlyPlan.planTable.summary: One line above the yearly-plan table. {{n}} = number of activities in the plan, {{total}} = the whole plan's budget in Nepali rupees. Must read correctly for one activity.
yearlyPlan.planTable.loading: Shown while the yearly-plan table is being read.
yearlyPlan.planTable.loadFailed: Shown when the yearly plan could not be read. Reassures that nothing was changed.
yearlyPlan.planTable.retry: Button next to the failure message: reads the plan again.
yearlyPlan.planTable.empty: Shown when the plan has no activity. It points at the “Add activity” button, so the wording must match that button.
yearlyPlan.planTable.drawConfirmBarAria: Accessible name of the bar that appears while you are drawing a place for an activity on the map (screen readers only — the bar itself shows no heading).
yearlyPlan.planTable.drawPointsDrawnInfo: Line in that bar: how many points you have placed so far, and what dragging or deleting one does. {{count}} = the number of points.
yearlyPlan.planTable.drawAreaChip: Small chip in that bar: the area of the shape drawn so far. {{ha}} = hectares, to 2 decimal places.
yearlyPlan.planTable.drawLengthChip: Small chip in that bar, for a drawn line only: its length so far. {{m}} = metres, rounded to a whole number.
yearlyPlan.planTable.drawFinish: Hover text of the tick button in that bar, which closes the shape and saves the place. The button shows only a tick, so this is the only text a sighted user sees. Must be very short to fit the button.
yearlyPlan.planTable.drawFinishAria: Screen-reader name of that tick button. Longer than the hover text because it is read on its own.
yearlyPlan.planTable.drawCancelAria: Screen-reader name of the cross button in that bar, which throws away the shape being drawn. Its hover text is the shared Cancel, not this string.
yearlyPlan.planTable.addRowPlaceholder: Placeholder of the box in the last, empty row of the yearly plan table: pick an activity there and it is added to the plan as a new row.
yearlyPlan.planTable.colSubArea: Column heading in the yearly plan grid: the sub-areas (user-drawn areas of the forest) the activity's drawn places fall in.
yearlyPlan.planTable.drawOnMap: Button in a row of the yearly plan grid, for an activity that needs a place: opens the map to draw that activity's place.
yearlyPlan.planTable.metricBudget: Option of the switch above the yearly plan grid: the year cells show and edit the budget (money).
yearlyPlan.planTable.metricLabel: Accessible name of the Quantity / Budget switch above the yearly plan grid (screen readers only).
yearlyPlan.planTable.metricQuantity: Option of the switch above the yearly plan grid: the year cells show and edit the quantity (area, length or count, in the activity's unit).
yearlyPlan.planTable.pasteDone: Message after cells copied from Excel were pasted into the yearly plan grid. {{n}} is the number of cells filled.
yearlyPlan.planTable.pasteInvalid: Error when a pasted cell is not a number; nothing is pasted. {{value}} is the text of the offending cell.
yearlyPlan.planTable.removeCancel: Button that keeps the activity when asked whether to remove it from the yearly plan.
yearlyPlan.planTable.removeConfirm: Question asked before an activity row is removed from the yearly plan, together with its years.
yearlyPlan.planTable.removeOk: Button that confirms removing an activity from the yearly plan.
yearlyPlan.planTable.removeRow: Accessible name of the x button that removes an activity row from the yearly plan (screen readers only).
yearlyPlan.planTable.yearTotals: Label of the foot row of the yearly plan grid: the total budget of each plan year.
